title: Swing Arm Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Double Arm | Fire Engine Red | Assorted Wall Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Get flexible towel storage that fits tight layouts in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. This wall-mounted swing arm towel rail (also called a towel bar, towel rack, or towel holder) gives you two arms that pivot independently, then fold in close to the wall when not in use for a space-saving bathroom setup.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom

- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 12 x 12 inches
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging with concealed screw mounting hardware
